tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear the Pink Tourmaline gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
Pink Tourmaline gemstone is a heart healer that addresses all of the negative feelings that have a negative effect on your character. Pink Tourmaline is utilized by healers whenever they must address deep-seated pain and mental turmoil. Whether you are suffering from a recent loss or old, buried childhood memories, this crystal's reassuring meaning and healing properties help you heal and move on. This stone radiates love, peace, and compassion at its core. These emotions can have a ripple effect on your life, allowing you to become a more rounded individual. Many consider Pink Tourmaline to be a stone of personal prosperity, understanding, and wisdom for this reason.

The core meaning of Pink Tourmaline is to remove any negativity that clouds your judgment, and this also applies to spirituality. Spirituality is considerably more profound than conventional ideologies or religion. It involves attaining enlightenment and gaining a deeper understanding of your place in the world. These inner demons are combated by the healing properties of Pink Tourmaline. It encourages you out of your stagnation and allows you to find the inner strength necessary to continue. It encourages you to rediscover your passion and mends your broken heart.

The word Tourmaline is derived from Thurmali a Sinhalese word, an Indo-Aryan language spoken in Sri Lanka. Thurmali in Sinhalese means stone of mixed colors. Tourmaline has existed since the 3rd century BC. But often confused with other stones, it only became Tourmaline at the end of the 19th century. This name comes from a Dutch merchant, who heard it when he went to look for stones in Sri Lanka. From the family of silicates, Tourmaline consists of alkalis and aluminum borosilicates with iron. It is a rather hard mineral, with hardness between 7 and 7.5 Mohs. Its density can vary from 2.90 to 3.25. It is a protective stone; it acts as a shield against negative energies. Pink tourmaline also helps overcome phobias and fears. It removes feelings of sadness and limits depression.

Meditation with pink tourmaline can bring to the surface and aid in the resolution of old emotional patterns, particularly those that are impeding your spiritual development. It can restore your sense of excitement and willingness to take risks in new relationships and ventures.

Pink tourmaline has been praised for its enigmatic properties throughout history, including its ability to get electrically charged upon being heated or rubbed – a property that was used in ancient times to draw ash out of smoking pipes.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Pink Tourmaline gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Pink Tourmaline. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Hrit Padma Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a feeling of soothing and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Pink Tourmaline is recommended for those haunted by depressing feelings, memories or emotions. It is also favorable for healers and those who practice meditation regularly.

It is also recommended for those having spinal problems or injuries, problems of the nervous system, neuralgia and migraines should also wear this stone.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Pink Tourmaline gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Pink Tourmaline gemstones.

Pink Tourmaline Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Pink Tourmaline raw is found many across the globe, however, gemstone quality Pink Tourmaline is mainly found in Brazil, California (United States), Sri Lanka, Mozambique, Africa, Namibia and Burma. Raspberry Pink-Red Tourmaline is mined in Brazil, California, and Namibia.

Observe their Color:

Pink Tourmaline is derived from Boron Silicate in combination with Iron, Magnesium and numerous other metals, making it one of the most complex crystal structures. It gets its color due to the presence of Manganese. The intensity of the Pink color varies with the amount of Manganese present in the stone. Some Pink Tourmaline stones have flawless transparent texture while some are opaque.

Notice their Clarity:

Pink Tourmaline is a translucent or opaque pink to magenta in several tones and it has a glassy shine when polished. Pink Tourmaline of premium quality display high degree of transparency.

Examine their Inclusions:

Pink Tourmaline has inclusions caused by the presence of lead and other minerals in the stone. This results in the formation of natural white inclusions which appear as white streaks or spots and stones with greater clarity, which are typically more valuable.

See their Shape:

Pink Tourmaline is usually available as tumbled stone polished into various shapes, including oval, round, cushion, pear, and square.

Check the Carats:

For the Pink Tourmaline of gem quality, the raw Pink Tourmaline is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Pink Tourmaline weighing between 2 and 6 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Pink Tourmaline is sold by weight, Pink Tourmaline prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Pink Tourmaline has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Pink Tourmaline

Due to treatments the Pink Tourmaline stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Pink Tourmaline do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Pink Tourmaline gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Pink Tourmaline are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Pink Tourmaline from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Pink Tourmaline gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Pink Tourmaline gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Pink Tourmaline is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality Pink Tourmaline stones are distinguished by their rich and vivid and no visible inclusions. The best ones have hue that is evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Cut

Best quality Pink Tourmaline stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Pink Tourmaline of 2 – 6 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Pink Tourmaline are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Pink Tourmaline rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Pink Tourmaline of premium quality display high degree of transparency. Pink Tourmaline with least inclusions and best clarity are considered the best.

Dealers deal in Pink Tourmaline which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Pink Tourmaline gemstone Price

The price of Pink Tourmaline gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. Darker pink tourmalines are more expensive, whereas lighter pink tourmalines are regarded as one of the best diamond substitutes. Whether darker or light, we seriously advise to procure natural, untreated pink tourmaline gemstones.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Pink Tourmaline has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Pink Tourmaline stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Pink Tourmaline gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 6,175 to INR 37,775 (USD 77 to USD 472).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Pink Tourmaline?

The best way to check the authenticity of Pink Tourmaline is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Pink Tourmaline are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Pink Tourmaline carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Pink Tourmaline is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Pink Tourmaline have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Pink Tourmaline, but if you find flaws, then your Pink Tourmaline is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Pink Tourmaline are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Pink Tourmaline. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Pink Tourmaline, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Pink Tourmaline from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Pink Tourmaline. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Pink Tourmaline. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Pink Tourmaline Cleaning & Maintenance

Your Pink Tourmaline might routinely carry negative energies, and the stone or ring can be detoxified by dipping it in saline water overnight. Pink tourmaline is also receptive to moonlight exposure, which aids for more cleaning and resetting.

Use clean, lukewarm water. If you wish to polish the stone slightly, you can do so with a mild soap. However, avoid using any chemical cleaners or harsh abrasives.

Pink Tourmaline is more delicate than most people realize, and all sorts of abrasive cleaning methods should be avoided.
